Auśanasatantra

Auśanasadhanurveda
or a.. saMhitA military science. Extr.. from this q. in Vīramitrodaya, Lakṣaṇaprakāśa have been ptd. (Au. dh. v. saṁkalana) with Hindi transl. Lahore, 1923. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1139-40. See also BDCRI. XIV. 1952, p.. 208. 209. This is supposed to be mentioned a. a source book in Hariharacaturaṅga (Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. p. 477) but the correct reading there is Īśānasaṁhitā (see edn. Madras Govt. Ori. Mss. Library p. 144). Kavīndrācārya 2158. [Page105-a.
